text: Hari Bansha Acharya (Nepali: हरिवंश आचार्य) is a Nepalese actor, comedian, director, singer, and writer, widely revered as the greatest comic comedian in the Nepalese television and movie industry, known for his method acting. He is one half of the comedy duo MaHa Jodi, along with Madan Krishna Shrestha. He is recognized for his performance as Arjun in the 1997 patriotic drama film Balidaan and for his role as "Hari Bahadur" in the series Madan Bahadur Hari Bahadur. He also wrote and performed in the film Shatru Gatey. Born on 27 Kartik 2014 BS (13 November 1957 AD) in Gairidhara, Kathmandu, he is the son of Homanjaya Acharya and Ganesh Kumari. He met his first wife, Meera, in 1982 and has two sons, Trilok Acharya and Mohit Acharya. Meera Acharya, who suffered from heart disease, died in 2011. He married his second wife, Ramila Pathak, in 2012. In 2015, he established The Meera Centre, named after his late wife, which provides health and educational services aimed at the holistic development of children under five years. Acharya performed with Hari Prasad Rimal and Jitendra Mahat Avilashi on Radio Nepal in 2031 BS (1974 AD), joined Rastriya Naach Ghar in 2032 BS (1975 AD), and participated in Gaijatra Mahotsav in 2034 BS (1977 AD). Before forming the MaHa Jodi with Madan Krishna Shrestha, he worked in the entertainment field for almost six years. He has appeared in several popular films, including Lovipapi, Filim, Rajamati, Silu, Balidaan, Je Bho Ramrai bho, and Tah ta Sarhai Bigris Ni Badri, with his performance in Balidaan considered one of his finest. Notable comedy series such as Lal Purja, Pandra Gatay, Bhakunde Bhoot, Series of Hari Bahadur and Madan Bahadur, 50/50, and Dashain ko Chyangra are cherished by Nepalese audiences. After 17 years with Shrestha, they starred in the 2074 multistarrer comedy-drama Satru Gate, whose story was written by Acharya; the film became a commercial success and is one of the highest-grossing Nepali films ever. Acharya and his comedy duo are active in social life and were notably involved in the April Uprising in Nepal, which dethroned the monarchy, with the duo being touted for the Presidency by some segments of the Nepalese population. A collection of his songs is available under "Hari Bansha Acharya (album)."
